meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 它先从你的 fork 里提取自定义改动，写成一份可重放的迁移指南；升级时在独立工作树里检出干净的上游代码，按指南重新应用，因此不再产生 git 合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游新版本或上游发生重构时触发。它分「提取」和「升级」两个阶段，若已有迁移指南会询问是否直接跳到升级。

say.text: 帮我从 fork 里提取自定义改动，生成迁移指南
say.note: 先检查工作区是否干净

say.text: 上游有更新了，把我的 fork 升级到最新版
say.note: 在工作树里重放指南后再落地

say.text: 更新已有的迁移指南，把新改动加进去
say.note: 只分析指南生成后的新提交

howto.what_en: It pulls your customizations out of a fork into a replayable migration guide, then upgrades by checking out clean upstream in a worktree and reapplying the guide. Nothing is merged, so there are no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Use it when your NanoClaw fork needs to move to a newer or refactored upstream. It has two phases, Extract and Upgrade; if a guide exists, it offers to skip to Upgrade.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations from this fork into a migration guide.
Upstream has new commits - upgrade my fork to it.
say_en.note: replays the guide in a worktree

say_en.text: Update the existing guide with my newest changes.
